item.title: Need help installing R
item.description:
Edit: i couldn't add a second picture, so here's the text of the error message: "An error occured while attempting to load the selected version of R. Please select a different R installation"
Hello everyone, I've got some serious problems installing R. I've downloaded the most actual version of R and RStudio - and unfortunately each time I receive an error message. I've installed and de-installed R and R Studio already 5 times - and each time there was that error message.
Anyone any ideas, what the problem could be?
Thanks in advance for your help !
